newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh hopes refugees will return from India.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh hopes refugees will return from India.

text.p: The repatriation of 43,000 Bangladeshi tribal refugees huddled in six camps in India's northeastern Tripura state will resume next month, and officials said on Monday they expect all will return soon. Some 50,000 tribespeople have fled the country's Chittagong Hill Tracts over the last ten years to escape a separatist insurgency by tribal Shanti Bahini guerrillas. About 7,000 returned home in the week-long first phase of the repatriation from March 28, following an agreement between the governments of India and Bangladesh. The repatriation process had boosted peace efforts in the Hill Tracts, officials said. "A formal (peace) deal is expected to be initialled between the government and the political wing of the rebel Shanti Bahini in the second half of June," one official told Reuters.
